export_image_count.caveat: Use actual COCO/export membership. Metadata totals may disagree; the reason is not established and omitted images are not inferred as negatives.

session_generalization.caveat: Native random image splits share inferred capture hours. Export date_captured is not acquisition time. Unknown camera/session metadata cannot be reconstructed.
session_generalization.group_definition: WIN_YYYYMMDD_HH from original filename; other names are unknown

train_purge.rule: Remove train rows whose decoded RGB image hash exactly equals a validation or test image hash. Preserve native validation/test membership and all remaining train rows. Do not remove shared capture sessions or use model outputs to choose exclusions.
